NLQ: Summarize variant info for each gene. Only select genes that have more than 10 variants. Order the results by the number of variants.
Expected query:
SELECT 
  gene_name, 
  CHROM, 
  COUNT(*)  AS total_variants, 
  SUM(CASE  WHEN  HighImpact = 1  THEN  1  ELSE  0  END)  AS  high_impact_count, 
  SUM(CASE  WHEN  ModerateImpact = 1  THEN  1  ELSE  0  END)  AS  moderate_impact_count, 
  SUM(CASE  WHEN  Synonymous = 1  THEN  1  ELSE  0  END)  AS  synonymous_count, 
  AVG(AF)  AS  mean_AF, 
  MIN(POS)  AS  start_pos, 
  MAX(POS)  AS  end_pos, 
  (MAX(POS) - MIN(POS))  AS  length 
FROM  varInfo_synthetic 
GROUP  BY  gene_name,  CHROM 
HAVING  total_variants > 10 
ORDER  BY  total_variants  DESC
Notes: The chatbot should interpret what the user means by “summarize variant info for each gene” and should be able to come up with a reasonable summary of the variant information for each gene. The chatbot should also be able to interpret the second part of the question “Only select genes that have more than 10 variants. Order the results by the number of variants” and include this in the query. However, there is no “correct” answer to this question, as there are many different ways to summarize the variant information for each gene. The important thing is that the chatbot can come up with a reasonable summary and can explain its reasoning in the answer.
